text:
Questions regarding the AS6 form for the B1 Visa application:

I am filling it out with ChatGPT because my technical Hebrew isn't sharp enough and I did it wrong the first time. 

1. According to ChatGPT, I do not need to fill out the first checklist page. Is that true?

2. The two sections where I need to sign in front of/ have my signature validated by a lawyer, can this be done at the magistrate? Can it be done virtually with a lawyer? Are e-signatures permitted?

3. For the last landlord page, I am subletting and the arnona is in the name of the person I am subletting from. I have the copy of my lease that states the arrangement (I reimburse him for arnona and vaad) as well as a letter from the person I am subleasing the apartment from and a copy of his tehudat zehut. I also have a copy of my internet bill just in case. Do I still need to have the owner fill that page out and sign in front of a lawyer or are my supporting docs enough? I couldn't get the confirmation from the municipality because the arnona is not in my name. 

I'm on a very compressed timeline and the free legal services I am using are falling short on the urgency. I really appreciate this group and all of your advice and help 🙏
